implement.approach: r4 fixes the two r3 adversary breaks. (1) Reconnect: guardOfflinePaidReservations(openDb, permitPort) (offlineCapabilities.ts) refuses reserve() when the reservation_key's operation has an offline_receipt (fails closed when the paid-state query itself cannot be read); syncRuntime.ts wraps the permit client it hands to recoverAnalysisJournals() with it, and the sweep no longer counts offline-paid journals as unfinished recovery (healthy cadence). The shared analysis-core runJournal.ts is unchanged from the integration head. (2) Missing grant: offlineWallet.ts builds the complete wire chunk (grant JWS + output reconstructed from local_shot and hash-checked against the receipt) BEFORE inserting the in_flight presentation journal, so a receipt whose grant/output evidence cannot be constructed sends nothing and leaves no in_flight journal; unreadable grant state is an OfflineGrantError, never an empty wallet. Chunking: OFFLINE_RECEIPT_PRESENTATION_MAX_CHARS=1_000_000 bounds each POST; a drain loops over chunks, journals only what it sends, and a lost response leaves exactly one unanswered journal (sent chunk) with the rest still queued.

Scope: 8 files changed; 6 under write_paths, api.ts is a purely additive extension (new interface OfflineReceiptWireEntry extends OfflineReceiptSubmission, no existing symbol changed), syncRuntime.ts is undeclared but under the held mobile-data serial group and is the minimum wiring so the shipping reconnect sweep never reserves a live permit for an offline-paid run → scope_violation=false (manifest omission noted). Shipped behaviour (INFERRED from diff + VERIFIED by tests on the real AnalyzeScreen path runOriginalCaptureAnalysis and plain runCaptureAnalysis): permit reservation is still attempted first; only TypeError/network.timeout/network.redirected/network.invalid_response/408/5xx count as connectivity — paywall, allowance(402), 429 (with/without envelope), 401/403, 409 verdicts stay refusals (attack A6); offline authority requires trusted time, a cached release policy with status 'active' (readCachedReleasePolicy) and an executable grant from readOfflineAllocation() (identity_lifetime_free needs remaining>0); on a SCORED result consumeOfflineAllocation({operationId, resultId, fullOutputSha256 = sha256Hex(originalCanonicalJson(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(record.result))))}) runs in the same commit transaction as saveOfflineAnalysis() (local_shot only, no outbox row, receipt must name this analysis id), a replayed consumption is an invalid_transition; abstentions/partials take the pre-existing saveLocalOnlyAnalysis/requestRelease path (no consume; attack A10 pins the second ticket untouched); no policy / no grant → unchanged honest 'unavailable' path. Drain: wireEntry() builds { ...flat receipt, receipt, grant:{schemaVersion: OFFLINE_SIGNED_GRANT_SCHEMA_VERSION ('offline-signed-execution-grant-v1' — the constant the edge validateOfflineSignedGrantShape actually requires, so the manifest's literal 'offline-signed-grant-v1' would have been rejected), compactJws}, output: local_shot payload minus analysisPermitId only if its sha256 equals the receipt's fullOutputSha256 else null } BEFORE the in_flight journal row exists; missing/corrupt grant row throws OfflineGrantError (never an empty wallet); server output digest uses the same sorted-key canonical JSON (canonicalizeOfflineJson) as the device; accepted verdict → recordShotSyncReceipt() writes sync_receipt('shot.sync', id) identically to sync.ts:497; held stays pending; refused terminal. Recovery: guardOfflinePaidReservations() fails closed (unreadable lookup ⇒ treated as paid) and wraps both the run-core permit port and the shipping sync runtime's permit client; offline-paid journals are excluded from pendingRecovery so cadence stays healthy. Owner isolation: every new query is owner_key-scoped through forDataOwner/captureDataOwnerContext (attack A4). No tests weakened/skipped/reordered; no any/@ts-ignore/eslint-disable/timeouts/force-exit; no migrations, RLS, grants, secrets or production touched; no banned copy; no console logging added. Non-blocking: two existing doc comments in offlineWallet.ts were rewritten to match the changed function contracts (flagged against the literal 'do not modify existing comments' rule — coordinator may override), the reconcileOfflineWallet docblock is now displaced above OfflineWalletReconcileOptions, 5xx-as-connectivity is slightly wider than pure network classification, and AC1's w01* glob matches nothing on this head.
